gates.acceptance: Physical phones and tablets on the supported OS matrix; accessibility service, large text, dark/light, rotation and landscape workflows.
Immutable encrypted intake, all artifact/audit/provenance/tamper checks, independently trusted checkpoints, protected transfer and approved tested recovery policy.
Actual supported file providers, microphone acquisition, authorized roles and the full accepted application workflow, with genuine user-interface interaction.
Declared device-specific RAM, descriptor, disk, duration, thermal and battery thresholds; sustained large-file, cancellation and cleanup measurements within those limits.
Process-kill and power-loss matrix at each long-running stage, source preservation, honest incomplete states, resumable jobs and protected clean-device recovery.
Native time-frequency selection, measured noise profiles, agreed disclosed restoration, delay, before/after comparison and non-destructive deterministic history/render/export parity.
Controlled multi-speaker/overlap and uncertainty accuracy evaluation; genuine score/word timing/alternative semantics; provider/model/deployment permission and policy qualification.
Authenticated roles, authorization/revocation/cross-user tests, explicit approved metadata fields, conflict handling and no hidden evidence synchronization.
Owner-controlled non-debug production signing, independently pinned certificate, upgrade/key custody and tested direct APK/MDM policy for the selected deployment.
Exact jurisdiction, organizational and case authority, retention/legal holds, licensing and required executed agreements reviewed for the actual deployed configuration.
Seven consecutive full accepted workflows on the exact release APK/source, after the other gates pass. A failure resets the consecutive counter; partial/subset runs never count.
